measurement.memory: GC 3 times with 50ms waits, then process Java heap, native allocated heap and PSS; ordinary and full share the same v3/v4 objects
measurement.baseline: same updated v1.7.263-pre.4 dictionaries with standalone matcher omitted; not an old-dev APK comparison
measurement.sessionWorkload: repeated identical full input, not sequential key entry

limitations: Debug build on one physical device; no release build timing or UI-to-display latency measured.
No peak-memory measurement. Both configurations retain the standalone object during paired timing.
Loading delta is a single GC-based sample. PSS/native deltas include process noise; the negative PSS delta does not indicate a memory saving.
Standalone matching only promotes qualifying one-node paths retained by normal graph/beam/bounded candidate search; does not generate new words.
